_comment: Specification, not a snapshot. Each case was reasoned from the rules, and BOTH the
Python spec (workers/seraphim/sos.py) and the JS Worker (api/src/index.js) must
satisfy every one. If the two implementations ever disagree, this file is right.
Rule: start at the highest base severity among the reported needs, then escalate
for circumstances that make any need harder to survive. Clamp to 1..5.

cases.why: no needs reported is not an emergency
unknown codes are ignored, not trusted
food alone is a supply run
drinking water outranks food
a boat is urgent movement
medical emergency is maximum
a missing person is maximum
trapped is maximum
dialysis interrupted is life-threatening
highest need wins, not the sum
an elderly person raises a food request
chest-deep water escalates any request
149cm is below the chest-deep threshold
waist-deep is dangerous for the vulnerable
waist-deep alone does not escalate the able-bodied
depth escalation cannot exceed the maximum
a large group needs a different response
nine people is still a household-scale response
escalations stack but clamp at 5
zero people is not a large group
infant formula is a vulnerability marker
pets do not raise human severity
pets alongside food do not escalate

age_cases.why: just under the threshold does not escalate
